title: Anwonwade a Ɛfa Adanse a Ɛnyɛ Komm Ho
intro: Wuhyia ɔsoro de ne ho gyee mu ho asɛm bi a wɔde mfonini akata so. Anwonwakwan so nsiesiei ne ahobammɔ a wontumi nka ho asɛm a ɛka bere tenten. So wubetumi ahu onii a ohyiaa sɔhwɛ soronko yi?
clues: Me nsa kaa ɔsoro nkrasɛm bi a ɛmaa me ho dwiriw me
Me nkurɔfo gyee m’ahotew ho kyim bere a me ne abofra san bae no
Wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ minni mmuada mfi kasa mu bere bi
Nsu ne date asubura bi boaa me wɔ m’asɔhwɛ no mu
M’Awurade yɛɛ anwonwade dua bi wosow de hwɛɛ me nea ehia me
Ɔbɔfo bi yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ me wɔ onipa a ɔyɛ pɛ tebea mu

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Awo a ɔno nkutoo na ɔwo wɔ mmɛ dua ase
Ɔkɔm a edi awu a wɔrehyia
Wɔtow no gu amoa a ogya wom mu
trial.answer: Awo a ɔno nkutoo na ɔwo wɔ mmɛ dua ase

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔdaa me ho adi sɛ me ho nni asɛm bere a me babarima a ɔyɛ akokoaa kasae no
Wɔnam ɔsoro asotwe so sɛee me nkurɔfo
Midii me man anim kɔɔ nkonimdi mu
outcome.answer: Wɔdaa me ho adi sɛ me ho nni asɛm bere a me babarima a ɔyɛ akokoaa kasae no

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
